title: Takeover Threats and Mandatory Disclosure Avoidance: Evidence from Contract Redactions
eligible_reason: Every regression includes eleven time-varying firm controls (lnsize mtb lev roa return_ann retvol prodmktfluid rd rd_missing lnanalyst instown_perc) and the treat and post main effects as separate regressors next to treat_post, which the protocol excludes. The sample is a stacked firm x hostile-takeover-deal panel (29 deals, fiscal years 2008-2018; the same firm-year appears up to four times across deals and treated status is deal-specific, sig_evertreat), estimated with firm and year FE in the main columns and firm x deal / year x deal FE in the explicitly stacked columns. Not an unstacked staggered TWFE with a binary absorbing treatment.
design_notes: sample_main.dta: 6,022 firm-deal-year rows, 1,447 permnos, 29 SDC hostile-takeover deals (master_deal_no), fyear 2008-2018; treat = peer firm of the target; post = years y+1, y+2 after the announcement (pre2, post1, post2 dummies for Table 4 dynamics). Table 3: reghdfe redact_file_rate / redact_ex_rate treat post treat_post controls, absorb(permno fyear) vce(cluster permno). Table 4: treat x pre2/post1/post2. Table 5A: never-treated controls (sig_evertreat != 1), stacked DiD (firm_deal, fyear_deal FE), entropy balancing [pweight=_webal]. Table 5B: alternative control group. Table 6C/7: contract-type outcomes and splits by trade secrecy / CEO excess pay. Table 8: international M&A-law DiD (ma_law_post, industry + year + country FE, no firm FE). Table 9: industry-level real effects.
estimators_reported: stacked_did (firm x deal, year x deal FE)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: 29 hostile-takeover deals announced 2009-2016 (deal-specific post windows); design is stacked by deal, not a unit-level absorbing adoption.
never_treated_note: Control peers; Table 5A restricts to firms never treated in any deal (sig_evertreat != 1).
screener_notes: Time-varying controls and treat/post main effects in every column; stacked firm-deal structure. Not eligible as reported.
